head.t: Pascal Precision system gains US FDA approval for tricuspid valve repair
head.x: Edwards Lifesciences has announced that the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved its Pascal Precision system for tricuspid valve repair.

head.t: Size adjustable pulmonary valve gains US FDA approval
head.x: Edwards Lifesciences has announced that the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved the Autus size-adjustable valve, a surgical pulmonary valve designed specifically for paediatric patients with congenital heart disease who require pulmonary valve replacement.

head.t: Framework ending 19 June 2027: Structural Heart and Ventricular Assist Devices
